label: copy phase: input k while outputting w (k->w bigram recall), from 4th output on
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and only when the input token is k (92% of mass) or w (8%). The core case is the copy-phase step where the model has just been fed k and must output w, i.e. the original sequence contained the bigram k w; this case alone holds about 76% of activation mass. Never fires on the first three outputs (recall_idx 0-2). Strongest activations (top ~12, 0.73-1.0 of max) all have k at original position 3 followed by w (recall_idx 4). Weaker activations: input k followed by some other token (often k still at position 3), and input w with output w or k (repeated w, or w k). Does not fire in the original or delimiter phase, nor on any input other than k/w. About 27% of k->w copy steps at recall_idx >= 3 stay silent, especially when k w falls at the very end of the sequence or in short sequences. Dev: P 0.73, R 0.57, F1 0.64, mass recall 0.76.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: k, w, -, x, g, f; least: v, e, 1, <DEL>) and the token being output (most: w, k, a, o, q, t; least: f, p, 1, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=9 & t=13.
